name: @sos-2/observation-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 Observation Plane acceptance suites (Work Order P7). Journey-level acceptance over the PUBLIC composition: a complete observation loop with NO body active (the entire plane runs with zero body/harness presence); GitHub push/PR events update live projections; runtime/CI evidence preserves truth states and provenance through the whole pipeline; stale/unavailable observation is distinguishable from success (freshness marks + typed findings); observation events are replay-safe (duplicate delivery never double-applies); observation never mutates semantic truth outside authoritative domain stores (write-counting wrappers prove only the observation-event store is written); and structural scans: zero new external dependencies, offline determinism, no forbidden ambient calls in the owned sources outside the documented composition boundary, and only merged + P7-owned workspace imports.
